The bow at the Holy Name
priest: standing · bow head-moderate · predella-gospel-corner · faces missal · eyes missal ·
AC1: standing · bow head-moderate · step-3-gospel · faces gospel · eyes downcast ·
AC2: standing · bow head-moderate · step-1-gospel · faces gospel · eyes downcast ·
VARIANT [exposition] When the Blessed Sacrament is exposed the prescribed bows during the
Gospel, the bow at the Holy Name included, are made toward the Blessed Sacrament rather than
toward the Missal. The approved baseline does not depict this case.
UNRESOLVED: The approved record fixes the direction of the bow at the Holy Name, toward the
Missal, but not its degree; the moderate head bow depicted here is the nearest fixed value and
the degree remains a serving-profile parameter.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
AC1 returns to his Epistle-side position
priest: standing · predella-gospel-corner · faces missal · eyes missal · joined-before-breast
AC1: standing · step-1-epistle · faces gospel · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
path step-3-gospel → plano-gospel → plano-centre → plano-epistle → step-1-epistle
AC2: standing · step-1-gospel · faces gospel · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
UNRESOLVED: AC1 may remain briefly on the Gospel side after placing the Missal before returning
to his ordinary Epistle-side position. The exact cue on which he returns was deliberately left
as a serving-profile parameter and is not fixed here.
UNRESOLVED: Whether AC1 genuflects at the centre as he crosses back is likewise unsettled by the
approved record; only the outward transfer path carries a recorded centre genuflection.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,

missal @ Held open in the priest's two hands, lifted clear of its stand at the Gospel corner.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
Per evangelica dicta: the kiss of the Gospel text
priest: stooping · predella-gospel-corner · faces missal · eyes missal · holding-missal
AC1: standing · step-1-epistle · faces gospel · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
AC2: standing · step-1-gospel · faces gospel · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
VARIANT [requiem] In a Requiem the book is not kissed and Per evangelica dicta deleantur nostra
delicta is omitted. The priest replaces the Missal on its stand without the kiss and without
those words, and the order continues as in LM-043A.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
The Missal moved toward the centre and the return to the centre

AC2: standing · step-1-gospel · faces altar · eyes altar · joined-before-breast
missal @ On the mensa toward the centre, just to the LEFT of the corporal as the priest faces
the altar, that is on the Gospel side of the corporal. [priest-reads-facing-left] — by priest
missal-stand @ On the mensa toward the centre, just to the LEFT of the corporal as the priest
UNRESOLVED: The moment at which the servers kneel again after standing for the Gospel is not
fixed by the approved record; it is left as a serving-profile parameter, and they are depicted
still standing at the end of this scene.
invariants: INV-FORM-01, INV-GEO-01, INV-GEO-02, INV-GEO-03, INV-MISSAL-01, INV-ROLE-01,
